NONHELDOUT_D3_PROVIDER_SMOKE
A projected wrapper exposes a field named version and forwards a request, but this synthetic smoke document intentionally does not supply authoritative target semantics, provenance, guard/effect binding, or a truth label. Classify only from the supplied bytes under the frozen prompt.

b3_provider_smoke.purpose: Availability and frozen request/response-shape closure only; D3 MUST NOT score semantic correctness, compare provider outcomes, tune prompts, select answers, or infer performance.
b3_provider_smoke.request_rule: Build each request only through the frozen request builder using the frozen config, prompt, response schema, and exact synthetic fixture manifest; send the emitted body without semantic modification.
b3_provider_smoke.response_rule: The first semantically valid provider response is binding. Normalize only with the frozen response normalizer. D3 pass requires normalized_outcome != BASELINE_INVALID for both lanes; the semantic outcome value is ignored for D3 closure.

execution_order: Verify exact runtime and repository-root PYTHONPATH.
Verify all historical D1 and D0 semantic locks plus D2 original/remediation frozen authorities before any provider request.
Materialize only the protocol-declared nonheldout D3 smoke fixture and manifest.
Build both provider requests with the frozen request builder and content-address the request artifacts.
Execute both frozen provider lanes under their exact endpoints/models with at most two transport retries and zero semantic retries.
Persist raw provider responses without printing their semantic content to logs.
Normalize both responses with the frozen normalizer and require neither lane to be BASELINE_INVALID.
Materialize and upload the complete D3 artifact before final PASS/FAIL assertion.
Freeze the first complete D3 result immutably on the authority branch regardless of outcome.

failure_semantics.after_any_provider_request_failure: Freeze the first-complete D3 result before diagnosis. No model/prompt/provider substitution or answer selection is allowed.
failure_semantics.d3_success: After immutable result freeze, Gate2E becomes authorized but Epistemic-10 remains unopened until a separate Gate2E execution protocol begins.
failure_semantics.pre_provider_preflight_failure: No provider smoke has been consumed. Only orchestration repair consistent with this protocol may proceed; identities, fixture, prompts, models, endpoints, mappings, and success rule may not change.

scientific_question: Before any Epistemic-10 exposure, are Gate2D identities, qualification evidence, semantic locks, runtime, and both frozen B3 provider lanes executable exactly as preregistered such that Gate2E may open without post-exposure identity repair?
